content: It's been an absolute honor to witness your intellectual curiosity and growth over these four years. You aren't just students; you're the future of this field. Go make us proud.
Alex, thanks for the 2 AM drafting sessions and the constant supply of caffeine. I wouldn't have made it through Sophomore year without your structural engineering advice!
To the whole Class of 2025: May your wifi be strong and your coffee be stronger in the real world. We did it!
Congratulations to all graduating seniors. Please remember to return your library books before the final ceremony!
